## Verification Checklist

Please verify each of the following before requesting a review:

- [ ] My code adheres to the code style and guidelines described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code in complex areas or added doc comments for new public APIs.
- [ ] My changes produce zero compiler warnings and pass `flutter analyze` with 0 warnings/errors.
- [ ] I have run `flutter test` and all unit/widget tests pass.
- [ ] I have run `dart test/verify_all_phases.dart` and all verification checks pass.
- [ ] I have tested this change on an Android device or emulator.
- [ ] Existing or new database migrations (if any) are properly handled via Drift.
